svg.aria-label: Llama-3.1-8B, tensor-parallel 8: throughput of each library as a share of plain vLLM
svg.text: Throughput as a share of plain vLLM doing the same generation with nothing attached (100% = vanilla).
Hollow = eager, filled = CUDA graphs. Whisker = min–max over runs. nnsight dots are smaller and in front, so a tie shows both. ✗ = cannot express.
Hover a dot for the number, its run count and range, and whether it is significantly faster than its nnsight counterpart (exact Mann-Whitney U, p<0.05, ≥3% apart).

svg.text: zero one attention head every step

circle.title: interp-engine vllm: no write to z / o_proj input: steering ops are add, orthogonal, projection_cap at residual points
interp-engine vllm-static: no write to z / o_proj input: steering ops are add, orthogonal, projection_cap at residual points
vLLM-Lens: hooks fire on decoder-layer outputs (and inputs) only; o_proj's input is not a hook point

nnsight taps (CUDA graphs): o_proj is not tapped on this engine (taps carry layer outputs only)
